newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLISH/SCOTTISH FIXTURES FEBRUARY 28 TO MARCH 2.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLISH/SCOTTISH FIXTURES FEBRUARY 28 TO MARCH 2.

text.p: English and Scottish league soccer
fixtures for February 28 to March 2:
Friday, February 28:
English division one - Tranmere v Stoke.
English division three - Colchester v Scarborough, Doncaster
v Wigan.
Scottish division three - Albion v Cowdenbeath.
Saturday, March 1:
English premier league - Blackburn v Sunderland, Derby v
Chelsea, Everton v Arsenal, Leeds v West Ham, Manchester United
v Coventry, Newcastle v Southampton, Sheffield Wednesday v
Middlesbrough, Tottenham v Nottingham Forest, Wimbledon v
Leicester.
English division one - Bradford v Manchster City, Grimsby v
Birmingham, Norwich v Huddersfield, Oxford v Crystal Palace,
Port Vale v Reading, Portsmouth v Sheffield United, Queens Park
Rangers v Oldham, Southend v Barnsley, Swindon v Charlton,
Wolverhampton v Ipswich.
English division two - Bournemouth v Shrewsbury, Bristol
Rovers v Walsall, Crewe v Gillingham, Millwall v Wycombe, Notts
County v Brentford, Peterborough v Chesterfield, Plymouth v
Blackpool, Preston v Bury, Stockport v Rotherham, Watford v
Bristol City, Wrexham v Burnley, York v Luton.
Scottish premier division - Aberdeen v Rangers, Celtic v
Hearts, Dundee United v Dunfermline, Hibernian v Motherwell,
Raith v Kilmarnock.
Scottish division one - East Fife v Dundee, Falkirk v St
Mirren, Greenock Morton v Stirling, Partick v Airdrieonians, St
Johnstone v Clydebank.
Scottish division two - Ayr v Berwick, Clyde v Queen of the
South, Dumbarton v Brechin, Livingston v Hamilton, Stenhousemuir
v Stranraer.
Scottish division three - Arbroath v East Stirling,
Inverness v Alloa, Montrose v Ross County, Queen's Park v
Forfar.
Sunday, March 2:
English premier league - Aston Villa v Liverpool.
English division two - Bolton v West Bromwich.
English division three - Swansea v Cardiff.
